title: Dua Lipa and Callum Turner Celebrate Second Wedding Ceremony in Sicily
summary: The couple first tied the knot during an intimate ceremony in London in May.
contentText:
Dua Lipa and Callum Turner have celebrated their love with a second wedding ceremony.

The British pop star, 30, and Fantastic Beasts actor, 36, reportedly exchanged vows again during a lavish ceremony in Palermo, Sicily, on Saturday (June 6), according to Vanity Fair .

The star-studded event was held at Villa Valguarnera, an 18th-century mansion, and reportedly welcomed around 300 guests. The newlyweds were serenaded by Elton John , who performed his classic hit “Your Song” while playing the piano.

Lipa and John previously collaborated on “Cold Heart,” whose PNAU remix reached No. 7 on the Billboard Hot 100 in 2021.

The couple’s Sicilian celebration drew an impressive guest list, including Donatella Versace, Joe Alwyn, Olivia Dean, Charli XCX and her husband, The 1975 drummer George Daniel. Also in attendance were Tame Impala frontman Kevin Parker and his wife, Sophie Parker, as well as Mark Ronson and his wife, Grace Gummer.

Music throughout the festivities was provided by Carl Cox, Martin Garrix, David Guetta and Peggy Gou, according to Vanity Fair .

The ceremony came just days after Lipa and Turner officially tied the knot during an intimate wedding at London’s Old Marylebone Town Hall on May 31.

In photos shared on Instagram following the London ceremony, Lipa stunned in a white Schiaparelli suit jacket and matching skirt, accessorized with a dramatic white hat. “31.05.2026,” the “Houdini” singer wrote in the caption of the snaps.

Lipa confirmed her engagement to Turner in June 2025 after months of speculation. The pair first sparked romance rumors in January 2024 when they were spotted together at an afterparty following the premiere of Masters of the Air.

Lipa recently closed the chapter on her Radical Optimism era, wrapping her global tour in December 2025 after more than a year on the road. Last month, the “Levitating” singer released Live From Mexico, a live album featuring performances from her three-show run at Mexico City’s Estadio GNP Seguros.
